desc: The Orlivane dog front leg sleeve covers one front leg and connects to a chest and shoulder panel that fastens over the back with a wide hook-and-loop closure. The navy knit fabric (98% cotton, 2% spandex) is soft and stretchy, and the elastic cuff keeps the sleeve snug at the lower leg. Use it to help stop licking of leg wounds, bandages and hot spots, or to keep the leg clean outdoors. Available in 8 sizes, XXS to XXXL; measure chest girth and leg length before ordering.
b: FRONT LEG COVERAGE — A long sleeve covers one front leg from the shoulder down to the wrist, helping keep your dog from licking or chewing leg wounds, bandages and hot spots. A comfortable alternative to a cone for leg areas.
STAYS IN PLACE — The sleeve is sewn to a chest and shoulder panel that wraps over the back and fastens with a wide hook-and-loop closure, so it does not rely on a single strap around the leg.
SOFT STRETCHY KNIT — Made of knitted denim-look fabric, 98% cotton and 2% spandex, soft and breathable for everyday wear indoors and outdoors.
ELASTIC CUFF — The elastic hemmed cuff sits snugly at the lower leg to keep the covered area protected and helps keep dirt off the leg on walks.
8 SIZES — XXS to XXXL by chest girth and leg length. Measure your dog and check the size chart before ordering. Manual measurement, allow slight deviation.
